title: Training-Free LLM-Based Recommendation with Post-LLM Item Refinement Using Collaborative Signals
abstract: arXiv:2608.19665v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise for training-free recommendation, but LLM-generated user interests are often too broad for fine-grained item retrieval. Existing methods incorporate collaborative filtering (CF) signals in a pre-LLM manner through candidate reranking or prompt augmentation, yielding limited gains. We propose CoRRe, a training-free recommendation framework with a post-LLM paradigm that injects CF signals into LLM-generated item representations, which are later matched with LLM-generated user interests for ranking. Specifically, CoRRe refines the directions of item embeddings using an item-item co-purchase graph and their magnitudes using item popularity. Experiments on real-world datasets show that CoRRe consistently outperforms existing training-free methods and achieves competitive or superior performance compared with training-based methods, without requiring any model training or task-specific fine-tunin

translated_title: 基于协同信号的后LLM物品精炼的无训练推荐方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.19665v1 公告类型：新 摘要：大型语言模型（LLMs）在无训练推荐中展现出潜力，但LLM生成的用户兴趣往往过于宽泛，难以进行细粒度物品检索。现有方法通过候选重排序或提示增强以预LLM方式整合协同过滤（CF）信号，但增益有限。我们提出CoRRe，一种采用后LLM范式的无训练推荐框架，将CF信号注入LLM生成的物品表示中，随后与LLM生成的用户兴趣匹配以进行排名。具体而言，CoRRe利用物品间共购图精炼物品嵌入的方向，并利用物品流行度精炼其幅度。在真实世界数据集上的实验表明，CoRRe持续优于现有无训练方法，并且与基于训练的方法相比，在无需任何模型训练或任务特定微调的情况下，达到具有竞争力或更优的性能。
tldr: 本文提出CoRRe框架，通过后LLM范式将协同过滤信号注入物品表示，无需训练即可显著提升推荐性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CoRRe, a training-free framework that injects collaborative filtering signals into item representations in a post-LLM manner, achieving superior recommendation performance without any training.
